name: Surge Technologies Inc.
summary: Surge Technologies Inc. (STCI), founded in 2000 and headquartered in Calgary, Canada, is dedicated to delivering electrical surge protection solutions for the telecommunications industry across both the United States and Canada. The company's core activities involve the development, production, promotion, and distribution of a variety of surge protection products. These include both standard and custom-designed electrical surge protection devices, as well as building entrance terminals. Beyond its product offerings, STCI provides a full spectrum of related services crucial for high-speed telecommunication networks. This encompasses specialized training on telecommunication connectivity and protection, along with practical support services like on-site inspections and installation assistance. Their services cater to telecommunication companies, other organizations, and individuals involved with managing telecommunications infrastructure.
